elements.name: Reverse the template name order in grouped Details view

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the user selects the standard inch part in the English folder
the user switches to the metric folder and displays grouped Details view
the previously selected standard inch part is displayed in the details pane
the visible part section lists two Sheet Metal entries before two Standard entries
the user clicks the Name column header
the visible part section lists the Standard entries before the Sheet Metal entries
the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units
the user clicks the Name column header again
the visible part section lists the Sheet Metal entries before the Standard entries
the details pane still identifies the standard inch part and inch units
the user restores Medium icons and cancels the chooser
the chooser closes and the original part remains active
